messages:
ana: Quick async design check on the Playground streaming UI. Recorded 60s screen share. TL;DR: where to put Stop/Regenerate, how live token count behaves, and prompt library behaviour when a stream is active. PTAL when you can.

mike: watched it. Two quick asks: don't bold in-flight text (layout jump), and move Stop out of header on small screens. I can mock a composer-adjacent layout. :+1:

jordan: Agree on moving Stop next to the composer. Also prefer skeleton rows for streaming text to avoid reflow. Implementation-wise I can emit partials as opaque placeholders until a token boundary to reduce jitter.

kevin: Accessibility checklist: Stop must be a native button, keyboard-focusable, have aria-label="Stop response" and announce when stream ends/cancels. Token counter contrast on dark failing WCAG for small text — either increase size or change color.

katie: UX question: live token counter during stream? My vote: show an estimated count with a tilde prefix ("~123 tokens") and then replace with final exact count on completion. Keeps transparency without noisy updates.

jordan: Backend already returns an estimate every 1s. I'll throttle client updates to 1s and round to reduce flicker.

ana: Copy + visual treatment idea: Stop as a filled destructive pill labeled "Stop response" and Regenerate as outline labelled "Regenerate"; visually grouped but distinct. Any objections?

mike: No objections. For mobile we should collapse Regenerate into a secondary menu but keep Stop always visible inline.

kevin: Also ensure that keyboard shortcut doesn't become the only way to stop. Shortcuts can be Alt+Shift+S / Alt+Shift+R but they must be optional and documented. Add a discoverability tooltip near the buttons.

sam: QA: I repro intermittent case where after Stop composer stays disabled. Filing bug with video (bug 1301). Add a finally handler to reset composer state on any terminal stream event.

jordan: Will add finally handler and basic unit test. Also will implement an "insert while streaming" confirm modal for prompt library: "Insert now and stop current response? [Insert & Stop] [Insert after]".

mike: UI mock note: token counter will shift into composer while streaming so related controls are grouped. Also proposing docking prompt library to the right so it doesn't cover messages.

kevin: a11y nit: keep a visible focus ring (3px) and ensure focus trap when prompt library opens. Tab order must go Stop -> Regenerate -> Composer -> Token counter.

katie: Small copy tweak: use "Streaming" indicator with live spinner and hidden text for screen readers that reads out "response streaming".

ana: Action items: Mike mocks for composer Stop/Regenerate and docked prompt library; Jordan implement skeleton streaming, throttled token estimates, finally handler; Kevin a11y checklist and contrast spec; Sam add regression tests; Katie final copy pass. I'll drop a short RFC and schedule a 15min async sign-off. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
